articles.title: Oil Price Today (November 24): Brent crude dips below $90 after hitting 3-month low. What’s happening?
articles.description: Crude oil price : Oil prices have declined as Brent crude hovered around $89 per barrel and WTI around $80. Diplomatic efforts between the US and Iran aim to resolve the ongoing West Asia conflict, creating market uncertainty. Recent Houthi attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure have raised concerns regarding regional oil supply security. Goldman Sachs and JPMorgan analysts predict potential price fluctuations based on geopolitical risks and supply disruptions.

articles.title: US eyes Iran as possible culprit in dozens of new cyberattacks against ships, WSJ reports
articles.description: The United States is currently looking into Iran's suspected involvement in cyberattacks against numerous energy tankers. Reports indicate that around 50 vessels carrying various hazardous materials have been targeted. Some ships have received threats warning of potential bombings due to these attacks. Both Iran and Russia are being considered as possible perpetrators by US authorities. This investigation reflects increasing concerns over broader cyber operations impacting international shipping and security.
